csharpCode: using System; using System.Linq; using System.Text; using UnityEngine; using UnityEditor; using UnityEditor.SceneManagement; public static class SavedGateCheck { public static string Run() { var b=new StringBuilder(); foreach(var path in new[]{"Assets/Scenes/Stage1.unity","Assets/Scenes/CompletScene.unity"}) { var scene=EditorSceneManager.OpenPreviewScene(path); try { b.AppendLine(path); foreach(var root in scene.GetRootGameObjects()) { foreach(var door in root.GetComponentsInChildren<GimmickDoor>(true)) { var so=new SerializedObject(door); b.AppendLine("Door "+door.name+" align="+so.FindProperty("alignArtworkLayers").boolValue); foreach(var key in new[]{"openSprite","closedSprite","frontRenderer"}) { var o=so.FindProperty(key).objectReferenceValue; if(o is SpriteRenderer r) o=r.sprite; b.AppendLine(key+"="+AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(o)); } } foreach(var w in root.GetComponentsInChildren<WeightSwitch>(true)) { var so=new SerializedObject(w); b.AppendLine("Switch "+w.name); foreach(var key in new[]{"restingBaseSprite","onSprite","pressClip","pressureCapRenderer"}) { var o=so.FindProperty(key).objectReferenceValue; if(o is SpriteRenderer r) o=r.sprite; b.AppendLine(key+"="+AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(o)); } var e=so.FindProperty("onPressed.m_PersistentCalls.m_Calls"); b.AppendLine("onPressed connections="+e.arraySize); for(int i=0;i<e.arraySize;i++) { var p=e.GetArrayElementAtIndex(i); b.AppendLine(p.FindPropertyRelative("m_Target").objectReferenceValue+"."+p.FindPropertyRelative("m_MethodName").stringValue); } } } } finally { EditorSceneManager.ClosePreviewScene(scene); } } b.AppendLine("compileFailed="+EditorUtility.scriptCompilationFailed); return b.ToString(); } }
